answer: Let attestations form a weighted graph, and propagate trust with a bounded-length random walk so influence cannot grow merely by multiplying identities. A sybil cluster with few links to honest nodes has low conductance; its sparse cut limits per-step incoming trust and, under bounded seed mass, bounds its aggregate voting weight. A thread of independent attestations can reveal a juniper-like cluster, while a mirror view of the graph helps detect support recycled within it.
